title: Azure Foundations: Administrative Evidence and Boundaries
summary: Ten original lessons connect Azure concepts to bounded local reasoning, accountable administration and explicit validation gaps.
limits: No Azure CLI, SDK, APIs, credentials, network access, provisioning or paid services are used. All real Azure operations are unexecuted. Partial AZ-900 concepts and broader administrative enrichment are not full AZ-900/AZ-104 coverage or practical readiness. AZ-104 effective-date verification remains incomplete because retrieved official material conflicted.
